name: io.github.twittrapi/twittrapi-mcp
title: TwittrAPI
description: Read public Twitter/X data: tweets, profiles, followers, search. No X developer account.

environmentVariables.name: TWITTRAPI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your TwittrAPI key. Set this or RAPIDAPI_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: RAPIDAPI_KEY
environmentVariables.description: RapidAPI key for the Twitter AIO API. Used when TWITTRAPI_API_KEY is not set.

environmentVariables.name: TWITTRAPI_RESPONSE_FORMAT
environmentVariables.description: Format of tool results: simple (compact JSON, far fewer tokens) or raw (X's full GraphQL JSON). Tools also take a format argument.
